cards.title: Spherical support at all points
cards.available: Pure-algebraic Hom_K has dimension1 precisely at the specified crystalline points, and zero elsewhere.
cards.needed: Restricted replacement for BM4.14 on all points, including nongeneric Frobenius.
cards.derivation: VI5.1 gives distinct-weight almost-de-Rham; VI6.13 upgrades nonzero locally algebraic vectors to de Rham before the later de-Rham comparisons. VI6.18 gives converse nonvanishing; VI6.30 supplies both directions of Jacquet/crystabelline comparison; VI6.33/50 identifies the unramified parameter.
